chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Abu Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

When salat (prayer) was performed over the woman and the man, the woman was placed forward and the man was placed behind. And when salat (prayer) was performed over the slave and the free person, the slave was placed forward and the free person was placed behind. And when salat (prayer) was performed over the elder and the child, the child was placed forward and the elder was placed behind.

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man, in the context of funeral arrangement
key_terms.الصَّغِيرِ: the child or younger one, given precedence in placement
key_terms.الْحُرِّ: the free person, in contrast to the slave
key_terms.الْعَبْدِ: the slave, in contrast to the free person
key_terms.الْكَبِيرِ: the elder, meaning the older deceased person
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman, in the context of funeral arrangement
key_terms.صُلِّيَ: salat (prayer) was performed, here referring to funeral prayer
key_terms.قُدِّمَ: was placed forward or brought to the front

ai.seo_question: How are multiple جنازة biers arranged in salat (prayer) over the dead according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the order of placement for funeral bier arrangements when different categories of deceased are prayed over together. It describes precedence in positioning between woman and man, slave and free person, and child and elder in the funeral salat (prayer).
